title: Schedule of Self-Pay Booking Deposits for In-Person Appointments
content:
**Self-pay booking deposit by visit type, In-Person Appointments.** The self-pay booking deposit is the deposit figure the visit type carries for a patient whose financial account is on the Self-Pay Account tier; a figure of 0.00 means the visit type carries no deposit. The refund period is the number of business days within which a booking deposit that becomes refundable is refunded.

| Visit type | Self-pay booking deposit (USD) | Refund period (business days) |
|---|---|---|
| Nurse Visit | 0.00 | 7 |
| Established Patient Office Visit | 75.00 | 7 |
| New Patient Office Visit | 125.00 | 7 |
| Annual Preventive Exam | 100.00 | 7 |
| Specialist Consultation | 150.00 | 7 |
| In-Office Procedure Visit | 200.00 | 7 |
| Advanced Imaging Appointment | 250.00 | 7 |

**Notes to the schedule**

1. The Nurse Visit is the one visit type whose self-pay booking deposit is 0.00.
2. The figures rise with the visit type: 75.00 for an Established Patient Office Visit up to 250.00 for an Advanced Imaging Appointment.
3. The refund period is the same, 7 business days, for every visit type.
